Method of Attack: Data wiping malware that erases data on computer systems
Overwrites data and hard disk MBR with random data
Uses dropper and modules (Wiper and Network) to handle disk wiping and communication with C2 server
Spreads through network via authenticated SMB sessions using credentials collected during reconnaissance
Impacted Systems: Private organizations in Middle East region
Saipem servers in Middle East, India, Scotland (Aberdeen), and Italy
Indicators of Compromise: Sample uploaded to VirusTotal from Italy on December 10, 2018
Attack Vector: Authenticated SMB sessions using credentials from reconnaissance stage
Dropper and modules deployed to infected systems
